The shop pages for both AirPods (3rd generation) variants return "Page Not Found" (e.g., `/shop/buy-airpods/airpods-3rd-generation/lightning-charging-case` and `/shop/buy-airpods/airpods-3rd-generation/magsafe-charging-case`) - The AirPods compare page only displays prices for currently available models (AirPods 5 at $149, AirPods Pro 3 at $249, AirPods Max 2 at $549), not for the discontinued AirPods 3rd generation ### Conclusion **Apple has discontinued AirPods (3rd generation)** from its online store. The compare page still lists the two variants for historical comparison purposes, but they are no longer for sale. As a result, the price difference between the Lightning and MagSafe Charging Case variants cannot be retrieved from the current Apple website.
